body:
Standup notes - 2026-07-01

Attendees: Maya, Liam, Priya, Noah, Ava, Tom (PM)

Quick updates:
- SDK: Release candidate 1.4.0 is in CI. Main wins in this release: improved streaming API ergonomics, types for function calling in TS, and smaller wheel size for python. CI green on Linux and macOS; Windows wheel failing in PyPI test (see DE-432).
- Samples/Quickstarts: TypeScript streaming quickstart updated to use ephemeral keys + example of chunked result handling. Embeddings quickstart smaller footprint and simplified pipeline for notebook users. Both quickstarts have new README templates.
- Docs: PR 401 (docs-site) added SDK reference scaffolding and placeholders for migration notes. Some pages blocked by API contract announcement. Search indexing appears to be skipping newly added quickstarts after the last build - likely pipeline or sitemap issue.
- Observability: chat-demo and embeddings-playground passed smoke e2e runs on main CI runners. We still need Windows-specific e2e for SDK packaging.

Blocker details:
- Windows wheel (DE-432): artifact built with incorrect platform tag; PyPI test fails during install on Azure Windows runner. Noah to reproduce locally and iterate on wheel tooling.
- Streaming disconnects: intermittent disconnects when using ephemeral keys observed only in CI for 10% of runs; appears related to short TTL reconciliation between key service and SDK. Liam to add retry/backoff and better logging.
- Docs search: new quickstart pages are present in repo but not appearing in search results; Priya to validate indexing logs and confirm whether lunr/elasticsearch step failed.

Decisions:
- Hold GA announcement for SDK 1.4.0 until Windows wheel fixed and API contract change is communicated to downstream teams.
- Quickstarts will include a Dedicated example only after Product confirms billing guidance; will keep a placeholder in templates for now.

Notes to follow up:
- Maya will draft the API contract change announcement and include a short migration guide and compatibility notes. Target circulation: 2026-07-02 morning.
- We should add a small test matrix in CI that includes Windows e2e for both packaging and streaming smoke tests. Action item assigned to QA.

Links referenced:
- SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/812
- Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-site/pull/401
- Jira: DE-432 (windows wheel), DE-441 (streaming disconnects)
- Confluence quickstart templates: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEVEXP/Quickstart+Templates

Action items summary (duplicate for visibility): see action_items list above.
notes_summary: SDK RC ready but Windows packaging and streaming edge cases blocking GA; quickstarts updated; docs migration progressing; action items assigned to fix packaging, search indexing, and streaming retries.
